verdict.rationale: vLLM is an inference and serving engine. A server like this could plausibly offer an assistant-configuration layer, such as an Assistants-style API, so the axis applies. The pack documents no feature for creating, saving or managing custom task-specific assistants. Multi-LoRA, tool calling and structured outputs are developer building blocks for constructing such assistants, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can create specialized custom assistants configured for specific tasks
